semantic_evidence.official_paper: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
semantic_evidence.review_note: The public -0813 release supersedes the preview checkpoint and attaches a three-stage DSpark module. Framework kernels, fusion, tensor-parallel collectives, scheduler behavior, and CUDA Graph capture are intentionally excluded from Model IR and attached only through Execution IR, bindings, and measured profiles.

model_ir: hidden, vocabulary, layer, head, low-rank, compression, window, and RoPE dimensions
mHC stream count, coefficient equations, Sinkhorn iterations, and residual transitions
CSA learned indexer, HCA deterministic compressed history, MQA, sink, and cache state
hash and learned expert routing, routed/shared expert math, and clamped SwiGLU
DSpark target features, three draft stages, Markov logits, confidence, and outputs
execution_ir: pure TP placement, sharding, collectives, payload layouts, and state ownership
binding_profile: framework source symbols, selected kernels, fusion, scheduler steps, CUDA Graph mode, and timing
excluded: training loss, optimizer state, evaluation sampling policy, tokenizer rendering, and deployment routing

implementation_details_excluded: CUDA, Triton, TileLang, FlashInfer, DeepGEMM, or FlashMLA kernel selection
physical cache page layout and scheduler slot allocation
fused launch decomposition and auxiliary stream scheduling
TP collectives and rank-local expert placement

runtime.model_step_support.equation: prepare positions, request slots, cache metadata, and sampling metadata without changing model values

model.decoder_stack.equation: R_61 = DecoderStack(R_0; 30 CSA layers, 31 HCA layers, MoE in every layer)

model.optional_dspark.equation: draft_ids, draft_logits, confidence = DSpark(target hidden layers 58,59,60) when explicitly enabled

decoder.layer_schedule.equation: for l=0..60 use CSA iff compress_ratio[l]=4, otherwise HCA with ratio 128

decoder.attention_choice.equation: delta_attn = CSA(x_norm) on 30 configured layers else HCA(x_norm) on 31 configured layers

decoder.attention_mhc_post.equation: R_attn[r] = post_attn[r] delta_attn + sum_s B_attn[r,s] R_l[s]

decoder.ffn_mhc_post.equation: R_(l+1)[r] = post_ffn[r] delta_ffn + sum_s B_ffn[r,s] R_attn[s]

mhc.combine_sinkhorn.equation: B = Sinkhorn_20(exp(scale_B b_raw + base_B)); rows and columns each sum to one

final_hc.pre_gate.equation: A = sigmoid(scale W z + base) + epsilon_hc

attention.window_kv.equation: kv_window = RMSNorm(x W_kv^T); apply RoPE to Dr suffix and quantize Dn prefix

attention.window_indices.equation: window_ids(t) = max(0,t-W+1)..t represented in the W-slot ring

attention.sparse_mqa.equation: o_h = Softmax(q_h K_selected^T / sqrt(D) with learned sink_h) V_selected

attention.grouped_o_a.equation: u_g = o_group_g W_oa_g^T for g in 0..Go-1

compressor.input.equation: x_block := hidden states assigned to one compression block

compressor.kv_gate_projection.equation: kv_j = x_j W_kv^T; gate_j = x_j W_gate^T + absolute_position_embedding_j

compressor.overlap_layout.equation: CSA emits current and one-block-shifted length-P windows; HCA emits one non-overlapping length-Ph window

compressor.norm_rope.equation: kv_comp = RoPE(RMSNorm(kv_bar)) with Dr rotary suffix

compressor.state.equation: partial_block_state_next = append(partial_block_state, kv_j, gate_j); emit and roll when block completes

compressor.output.equation: kv_comp := one compressed D-width KV vector per completed block

csa_indexer.input.equation: x and q_latent_raw := CSA input and shared query latent

csa_indexer.score.equation: score_p = sum_i alpha_i ReLU(q_i dot k_p)

csa_indexer.topk.equation: block_ids = TopK(score, min(Ki, completed_blocks)) under the causal block mask

csa_indexer.expand.equation: compressed_history_ids = offset + block_ids; each id addresses one compressed CSA KV vector

csa_indexer.output.equation: compressed_history_ids := selected CSA compressed cache positions

hca_history.input.equation: completed HCA compressed cache length and current position

hca_history.output.equation: compressed_history_ids := all causally completed HCA blocks

moe.learned_select.equation: expert_ids = TopK(s + correction_bias, K) for layer_id >= 3

moe.weights.equation: w_j = 2.5 s[expert_j] / sum_k s[expert_k]; selection bias is excluded from w

moe.dispatch.equation: x_e = stable group of token copies addressed to each selected expert

dspark.input.equation: current token id plus target hidden states from layers 58,59,60

dspark.stage_schedule.equation: apply three sequential DSpark decoder stages; stage 0 owns target projection and stage 2 owns heads

dspark_stage.input.equation: R_draft and main_x := stage residual state and target feature

dspark_stage.attention_mhc_post.equation: R_attn[r] = post_attn[r] delta_attn + sum_s B_attn[r,s] R_draft[s]

dspark_stage.ffn_mhc_post.equation: R_next[r] = post_ffn[r] delta_ffn + sum_s B_ffn[r,s] R_attn[s]

dspark_attention.input.equation: draft state x plus target feature main_x

dspark_attention.draft_qkv.equation: draft q and kv use the same low-rank query and shared-KV equations as target attention

dspark_attention.fixed_indices.equation: selected_ids = all W target-window slots concatenated with the G draft positions
